archetype: Hybrid Fullstack Developer Tool + Artisanal E-Commerce
design_narrative: A duality between the physical craftsmanship of Lumen Supply Co. (warm tactile slate, raw brass, obsidian, bone parchment, Swiss-editorial typography) and the invisible precision intelligence of ShadowQA (Zero-UI ambient agent, sub-millisecond dark-mode glassmorphic HUD, monospaced diagnostic telemetry, and surgical diffs).

theme_strategy.lumen_store: Artisanal Outdoor Precision (Light/Warm Canvas default with deep charcoal structure and amber/burnt ochre kinetic triggers)
theme_strategy.shadow_qa_overlay: Shadow DOM Dark Obsidian HUD (Zero-UI when healthy, floating ambient dot, surgical incident card, monospaced diff viewer, multi-stage replay checklist, and 11-tab drawer)

fonts.overlay_ui: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, monospace

--sqa-dim: #64748B; --sqa-red: #EF4444; --sqa-green: #10B981; --sqa-amber: #F59E0B; --sqa-cyan: #06B6D4; --sqa-indigo: #6366F1; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--sqa-text); } .sqa-dock { position: fixed; bottom: 20px; right: 20px; z-index: 999999; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 10px; pointer-events: none; } .sqa-interactive { pointer-events: auto; } .sqa-pulse-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 12px currentColor; } .sqa-card { width: 380px; max-width: calc(100vw - 32px); background: var(--sqa-bg); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border: 1px solid var(--sqa-border); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding: 16px; overflow: hidden; animation: sqaSlideUp 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } @keyframes sqaSlideUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px) scale(0.98); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); } } .sqa-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .sqa-badge-low { background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15); color: #34D399; border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3); } .sqa-badge-medium { background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15); color: #FBBF24; border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3); } .sqa-badge-high { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15); color: #F87171; border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3); } .sqa-diff-view { background: #07080A; border: 1px solid var(--sqa-border); border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px; margin: 10px 0; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; overflow-x: auto; } .sqa-diff-del { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12); color: #F87171; display: block; padding: 1px 4px; border-left: 2px solid #EF4444; } .sqa-diff-add { background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12); color: #34D399; display: block; padding: 1px 4px; border-left: 2px solid #10B981; } .sqa-diff-ctx { color: #64748B; display: block; padding: 1px 4px; } .sqa-checklist-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 11px; padding: 4px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04); } .sqa-drawer { position: fixed; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: 680px; max-width: 100vw; background: #090A0D; border-left: 1px solid var(--sqa-border); z-index: 1000000; box-shadow: -20px 0 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.7); display: flex; flex-direction: column; animation: sqaDrawerIn 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } @keyframes sqaDrawerIn { from { transform: translateX(100%); } to { transform: translateX(0); } } .sqa-tab-btn { padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: var(--sqa-muted); transition: all 0.15s ease; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; border-top: none; border-left: none; border-right: none; white-space: nowrap; } .sqa-tab-btn.active { color: #FFF; instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Render ShadowQA inside a Shadow DOM wrapper (or strict scoped isolation) with CSS variables matching the dark HUD theme, maintaining Zero-UI philosophy when healthy (a tiny, unobtrusive, calm indicator at bottom-right).

2. Build the full Lumen Supply Co. demo store: Navigation with Brand / Products / Orders / Dashboard / Settings / Cart counter, Hero with authentic outdoor photography, Filterable product grid, Product detail modal or slide-over, Interactive Cart with quantity modifications, Checkout flow with billing fields and real test failure trigger toggle ('Simulate Payment Gateway Failure' vs 'Normal Checkout'), Orders history, and Settings tab.

3. When a failure occurs (either triggered by user clicking 'Fail Checkout' or selecting 'Simulate Payment Failure'), immediately activate the ShadowQA HUD card: '🔴 ShadowQA / Checkout failed / Root cause src/payment/checkout.js:87 / Confidence 96% / Risk LOW / [View Fix] [Dismiss]'.

4. Clicking [View Fix] opens the minimal human-readable diff, shows the 4-step validation evidence, allows clicking [Apply & Replay], runs the step-by-step visual replay checklist with checkmarks ticking in real-time, and concludes with green verdict '🟢 FIX VERIFIED / UI RECOVERED'.

5. Include an [Open Inspector / Advanced Drawer] button that slides out the technical dark-mode drawer with all 11 tabs (Timeline, Graph, Network, Source, Diagnosis, Patch, Validation, Replay, Health, Memory, Agent Telemetry), packed with high-density production developer data.
6. Include a 'Trigger Fault Injection' control in the header or footer so evaluators can inspect ShadowQA anytime even if they haven't added items to cart.

7. All buttons, tabs, inputs, and status badges MUST carry distinct data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='sqa-incident-card', data-testid='sqa-apply-fix-btn', data-testid='checkout-pay-btn', etc.).
